newsitem.title: SPAIN: Basque ETA separatists free second hostage.
newsitem.headline: Basque ETA separatists free second hostage.

text.p: The Basque guerrilla group ETA freed a second hostage on Tuesday, prison worker Jose Antonio Ortega Lara, who had been held by the group for almost two years, police said.
Earlier on Tuesday, ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) freed Basque businessman Cosme Delclaux who had been held captive for 232 days.
Police said four Basque separatists had been arrested after Ortega Lara's release. The prison worker was freed close to the northern Basque town of Mondragon.

Just hours earlier, Delclaux, 34, was found drugged and tied to a tree near Bilbao after newspaper EGIN, which is closely tied to ETA, received an anonymous phone call informing of his release, police said.
ETA have waged a 29-year struggle for independence from Spain in which 800 people have been killed.
Spain's centre-right government has insisted that no peace talks with ETA were possible as long as the group holds hostages.
